w: ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’
k: Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

w: ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
k: Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

w: ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
k: Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

w: ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
k: Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

w: ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
k: I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

w: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’
k: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

w: “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah
for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
k: Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

w: “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
k: Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

w: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
k: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

w: “Ananias!”
k: Ananias.

w: “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
k: Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

w: But
rise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
k: Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

w: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
k: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.

w: “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
k: I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

w: “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
k: Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

w: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
k: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

w: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
k: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

w: “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
k: wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

w: “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
k: It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

w: “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
k: What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

w: “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
k: Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

w: ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
k: Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

w: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
k: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

w: delivering you from the people, and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,
k: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

w: ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
k: I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

w: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen, and of the things which I will reveal to you;
k: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;

w: ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
k: What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

w: ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
k: John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

w: ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
k: Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

w: “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
k: Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

w: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
k: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
